== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Ion Cannon with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160807002303/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Premiere-Dark/large/ioncannon.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Ion Cannon (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-5/5b/Premiere-D-ioncannon-PC-Errata-disc.gif Internet Archive item].
